neighbours.label: physical length or distance measured along an object (fret-to-nut distance, contracted length, focal length)
fire: Measure from the nut to the center of the twelfth fret to find the scale length.
A moving rod's length is contracted along its direction of motion.
The zoom covers focal lengths from 24 to 70 millimeters.
The beam spans six meters from one wall to the other.
Cut the pipe so its length matches the distance between the brackets.
The wavelength is the distance between two neighboring crests.
Mark the board halfway along its length before sawing.
The diagonal of the screen measures fifteen inches from corner to corner.
quiet: Weigh the guitar body before and after you add the new hardware.
A moving clock runs slower than one at rest, by the factor gamma.
The zoom lens weighs about 800 grams with its hood attached.
The beam carries a load of two tons without bending.
Heat the pipe until the solder melts and flows into the joint.
The frequency is the number of crests passing each second.
Sand the board until the surface feels smooth to the touch.
The screen glows brighter once the battery is fully charged.

notes: Card mixed: ' the' in 'from the nut ... to the center of the 12th fret', 'its length is contracted', 'focal lengths', code with radius/axis. + pole is angular size in astronomy (promotes ' angle'), - pole suppresses ' along', ' longitudinal'. Near misses: same physics/craft topics with mass, time or temperature instead of length.
